products.title: Wall Crack & Nail Hole Filler Putty 150ml – Quick-Set Repair

description.plain:
Restore your walls to a flawless, smooth finish with this easy-to-use Wall Repair Putty. Whether you're dealing with unsightly cracks, nail holes, or minor surface damage on drywall or plaster, this 150ml filler putty delivers a professional-quality result without the need for a contractor. Its smooth, creamy consistency glides on effortlessly — even for first-time DIYers.

Key Features

  • Versatile Wall Repair: Designed to fill cracks, nail holes, and surface blemishes on drywall, plaster, and most interior wall surfaces.
  • Smooth & Creamy Formula: Easy to apply, spread, and feather for a seamless blend with your existing wall surface.
  • Waterproof & Mold-Resistant Finish: Specially formulated to withstand moisture and resist mold growth, ensuring a long-lasting, durable repair.
  • Quick-Setting: Dries fast to a strong, solid finish that holds up to everyday wear and tear — ready to sand and paint over in no time.
  • Paintable White Finish: Dries to a clean white that accepts paint without primer bleed-through, for a truly invisible repair.
  • Includes Applicator Head: Each tube comes with an applicator head for precise, mess-free application directly to the damaged area.
  • Compact 150ml Size: Ideal for home touch-ups, moving-out wall repairs, and small renovation projects.

Specifications

  • Product Name: Wall Repair Putty
  • Volume: 150ml
  • Color: White
  • Material: Putty Powder
  • Includes: 1 x Putty Wall Repair Tube (with applicator head)
  • Country of Origin: Made in China

How to Use

  1. Clean the damaged area — remove any loose debris, dust, or flaking paint.
  2. Attach the applicator head and apply the putty directly into the crack or hole.
  3. Smooth with a putty knife or the included head, feathering the edges for a flush finish.
  4. Allow to dry fully, then lightly sand if needed.
  5. Paint over for a completely invisible repair.

You May Also Like

Keep your home looking its best with other handy tools and accessories from our store:

  • BALASHOV 2500W Handheld Steam Cleaner – Kitchen, Car & Home
  • Garden Pruner Shears – Secateurs for Bonsai & Fruit Trees

Learn more: OSHA on eye and face protection

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What surfaces is this wall repair putty compatible with?

A: This wall repair putty is suitable for most common interior wall surfaces, including drywall, plaster, and similar materials. It is ideal for filling nail holes, hairline cracks, and minor surface damage to restore a smooth, even finish ready for painting.

Q: How long does the putty take to dry before I can paint over it?

A: This quick-setting wall filler putty dries rapidly under normal indoor conditions. Drying time can vary depending on the depth of the repair and ambient humidity, but in most cases the surface is ready to sand and paint within a short time after application. For deeper fills, allow additional drying time for best results.

Q: Is this wall filler putty waterproof?

A: Yes — the formula is designed to provide a waterproof and mold-resistant finish once fully cured, making it a durable and long-lasting solution for interior wall repairs.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

What kind of damage is this putty best for?
It is designed for small household touch-ups such as wall cracks, small holes, tile chips, tile edge gaps and openings around pipes or cables.
Can I use it to repair tile?
It can be used for small tile touch-ups such as shallow chips, minor cracks and gaps along tile edges. Press the putty firmly into the damaged area and shape the surface to match the surrounding area as closely as possible.
Can it fill narrow wall cracks and gaps?
Yes. Its soft moldable texture makes it useful for pressing into small cracks, holes and narrow irregular seams.
Do I need to mix it before using it?
No. Take out the amount you need, knead it by hand and press it directly into the repair area. No powder mixing or bucket preparation is required.
Do I need special repair tools?
No special mixing equipment is required. For many small repairs the putty can be kneaded, shaped and pressed directly by hand.
Where can I use it?
It is useful for small wall cracks, holes, tile chips, tile edge gaps, openings around pipes and cables, and other irregular household gaps where a moldable filler is convenient.
How do I apply it?
Clean and dry the repair area first. Knead the putty until it becomes easy to shape, press it firmly into the crack or gap, then smooth and shape the exposed surface.
How much comes in one set?
The set contains 10 individually packed pieces, approximately 30 g per pack.

Fill, Seal & Restore Any Surface in Minutes

Say goodbye to unsightly cracks, holes, and gaps with this Universal White Wall Repair Putty. Formulated for fast drying and a long-lasting seal, this versatile putty is the go-to solution for homeowners, renters, and DIY enthusiasts tackling both indoor and outdoor repair projects. Its smooth white finish blends seamlessly with walls, ceilings, tiles, and more.

Key Features

  • Quick-Drying Formula: Sets rapidly so you can paint or refinish surfaces faster without long wait times.
  • Long-Lasting Seal: Provides a durable, weather-resistant bond that holds up against moisture, temperature changes, and everyday wear.
  • Universal Application: Suitable for drywall, plaster, concrete, tile grout lines, brick, and more — indoors and outdoors.
  • Smooth White Finish: Dries to a clean white color that's easy to sand, prime, and paint over for a flawless result.
  • Easy to Apply: Spreads smoothly with a putty knife or finger, making it accessible for professionals and beginners alike.
  • Versatile Repair: Ideal for filling cracks, holes, gaps, and damaged grout lines on walls, floors, and exterior surfaces.

Ideal Uses

  • Wall crack and hole filling (interior rooms, hallways, bathrooms)
  • Tile grout repair and re-sealing
  • Exterior wall and facade crack repair
  • Concrete and masonry patching
  • Pre-paint surface preparation

Type Tile Grout / Wall Repair Putty
Color White
Application Indoor & Outdoor

A: Yes! This universal wall repair putty is specifically designed for both indoor and outdoor applications. Its weather-resistant, long-lasting seal makes it suitable for exterior walls, facades, concrete, and masonry surfaces exposed to the elements.

Q: How long does the wall repair putty take to dry?

A: The quick-drying formula sets in a short time under normal conditions, allowing you to sand, prime, or paint over the repaired area relatively quickly. Drying time may vary slightly depending on the thickness of application and ambient temperature or humidity.

Q: Can I paint over this putty after it dries?

A: Absolutely. Once fully dry, the white putty surface can be sanded smooth, primed, and painted over with standard wall paints for a seamless, professional-looking finish.

Q: Is this putty safe to use indoors without special ventilation?

A: This product contains no high-concern chemicals as listed in its specifications. However, as with any repair compound, it is good practice to ensure adequate ventilation when working in enclosed spaces.

A featured variant may already answer the user's needs; use get_product only for other options or a concrete missing fact. Preserve the exact variant and seller. Create a basket or checkout only for user-directed basket, quote or review intent.

For useful adjacent alternatives, use search_catalog with one returned product or variant ID in `like`. Keep hard requirements in supported filters; preserve and verify the rest. Never substitute without user approval.
